question_of_interest: Does matched full-wave time reversal improve simulated focal localization relative to baseline in frozen Case079 at 250 kHz?
context_of_use: Single-case, within-model engineering comparison; not an absolute-pressure, safety, efficacy, or population-prediction claim.
rules: Thresholds are project acceptance targets, not universal standards.
Unaligned preregistered benchmark metrics remain primary; post-hoc shift or gain fits are diagnostic only.
A failed or interrupted run is not imputed, resumed into the same evidence unit, or silently replaced.
Absolute pressure remains model-specific until experimental validation is completed.

checks: finite pressure field and scalar metrics
configuration, device, monitor, and hash manifests retained

pml_sensitivity.paired_variables: PML12 versus PML16 with all other settings frozen and fields aligned on the common physical domain

time_step_sensitivity.paired_variables: CFL0.2 versus CFL0.1 with grid, PML, source, model, crop, and simulation time frozen

grid_sensitivity.paired_variables: dx0.75 mm versus one finer registered-grid configuration with physical model, source, target, PML thickness in physical units, CFL, crop, and duration controlled

itrusst_phase_a_external_benchmark.justification: The ITRUSST intercomparison reports cross-model median focal-pressure and focal-position differences below 10% and 1 mm; it does not prescribe a universal pass/fail threshold. The 20% field-L2 target is therefore an explicit project choice.

public_270khz_experimental_validation.role: method-level external validation using independent CT and hydrophone measurements; not subject-specific validation of Case079

current_single_case_engineering_claim.allowed: TR improved simulated localization in one frozen case and the result was insensitive to the tested PML perturbation.
